headline: Nokia Reports 9% Q3 Revenue Growth Driven by AI Demand
summary: Nokia reported third-quarter revenue growth of 9 percent, bolstered by rising demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure, while noting higher restructuring costs.
why: Nokia is a leading global telecommunications equipment manufacturer providing networking infrastructure for enterprise and telecom operators.

impacts.name: Nokia Oyj
impacts.why: Strong top-line growth driven by artificial intelligence demand validates the company's pivot toward high-bandwidth networking markets.

why_moved: Accelerating revenue growth linked to artificial intelligence tailwinds surpassed market expectations, boosting investor sentiment.
